title: Battery #7 — decision boundary (what would flip the answer)
passCriteria: The walk must describe a REAL boundary in terms of statuses/geometry (e.g. 'if Commitment were Balanced rather than Too Little...'), not narrative hedging. FAIL if it answers without locating the boundary.
questions: Is the ground solid under this venture? Also: state exactly what would have to be different in this draw for your answer to become its opposite.
